instruction_note: This fragment declares NO task_instruction and NO task_instruction_template: the system message of every contact is that draw's own rendered proposer instruction (rails.proposer.render_slurp_proposer_instruction, verbatim in section 5 of the preregistration), resolved at flight time from the committed proposer roster, A_0's floored and unfloored TRAIN tables, the incumbent state and the carrier's TRAIN construction rows. It is never written to a receipt: a proposer prompt carries construction utterance text and gold entities, and rails.evolution.ProposerContact.as_json records identity, counts and digests only.
modality_note: TEXT ONLY. The construction-proposer-text arm's D2-frozen field set carries construction_targets and no speech field, so no audio part is sent and no packet is opened. The exemplars reach the prompt as their TRAIN transcript plus their gold entity list -- the legality owner decision 2026-09-05 opened for this arm alone, over SLURP-EVO-EXEMPLARS-V2 and no other roster.
roster_note: construction_proposer_roster_receipt, its split identity hash and construction_target_tools are declared by the PER-ROUND experiment fragment scripts/run_evolution_round.py emits, because the roster is per round and core.config.compose refuses the same key from two fragments.
scoring_note: Only the 'cost' scorer. A proposer response is an ARTIFACT -- a scenario's rewritten slot-schema blocks in the renderer's own grammar -- not an answer to a scored row, so SLURP's own scorers would be scoring the wrong thing and would need gold these construction samples have no business resolving. The candidates are produced afterwards, model-free, by rails.evolution.harvest_proposer_responses over the sealed manifest, and every one of them then faces the form gates, the +20 percent relative token budget on the flight tokenizer and the committed decontamination digests.
split_id_note: split_id is declared by the PER-ROUND experiment fragment the driver emits, from the loop config's split_ids mapping, because it is a property of the population and not of the arm.
user_turn_note: NEITHER user_turn_text NOR user_turn_audio_first is declared, and the omission is load-bearing twice over. core.model.transport.LlamaServerTransport refuses an EMPTY user_turn_text outright ('an empty user text part would put a meaningless content part on the wire'), and it refuses ANY user_turn_text under the speech-feature prompt orders this fragment's model fragment declares, because those orders own their own user-content ordering. A proposer contact's user turn is the empty content list core.flight.runtime._run_construction_proposer sends; the whole instruction is the system message. configs/baseline/a2t-evo-a1-proposer.json still carries user_turn_text: "" and would fail the same way on its first flight; it belongs to the EVO-A1 track and is left for that track to fix.
what_this_is: The PROPOSER arm of cell EVO-S1, the SLURP sibling of configs/baseline/a2t-evo-a1-proposer.json. Its model fragment is q4km-mmproj-free-speech-native-np4-proposer-max1536 (the reward fragment with max_tokens 1536), named by the loop config's proposer_model_fragment.
